articles.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers
articles.snippet: BTCPay told users running LND to update immediately or take servers offline after attackers stole credentials that can control Lightning wallets and move funds.

articles.title: U.S. widens Iran crypto crackdown with sanctions on two exchanges
articles.snippet: The Treasury's OFAC targeted Shelbit and Aban Tether as Washington continues its effort to cut Tehran's access to crypto and foreign currency.

articles.title: Domestic stablecoins could boost demand for dollar-backed tokens: IMF
articles.snippet: IMF first deputy managing director Dan Katz says users may favor digital dollars for their liquidity, network effects and cross-border acceptance.

articles.title: CLARITY Act delay gives Asian financial hubs an opening: First Digital CEO
articles.snippet: Industry figures warned that continued legislative limbo could slow institutional adoption, revive regulation by enforcement and push innovation offshore.

articles.title: US appellate court mandate affirms Sam Bankman-Fried conviction
articles.snippet: Three circuit judges disputed the former FTX CEO’s claims that the defunct crypto exchange’s investors could have been made whole and wouldn’t have experienced any losses.
